name: pixel-image
title: Pixel Image
description: A component that displays an image with a pixelated effect, creating a retro aesthetic.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternative text for the whole image (the pixels themselves are hidden from assistive tech). Addition.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the container (default `h-72 w-72 md:h-96 md:w-96`). Addition.

props.name: customGrid
props.description: Custom grid with 1–16 rows and columns. Takes precedence over `grid`.

props.name: grayscaleAnimation
props.description: Fade from grayscale to full colour.

props.name: pixelFadeInDuration
props.description: Milliseconds each pixel takes to fade in.

props.name: maxAnimationDelay
props.description: Maximum random delay, in milliseconds, before a pixel fades in.

props.name: colorRevealDelay
props.description: Milliseconds before the colour is revealed.
